config.notes: SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK FP-20: FHIRPath — §9 Environment Variables; §10 Types and Reflection; §11 Type Safety; §12 Formal Specifications. Test these items: Environment variable access (%context, %resource, etc.); Model information; SimpleTypeInfo; ClassInfo; ListTypeInfo; TupleTypeInfo; Type safety rules; Formal syntax (ANTLR); URI and media types. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.
